name: Wand Division (Item Creation)
body:
You can create two wands from one wand.

Prerequisite(s): Craft Wand, caster level 9th.

Benefit(s): In a 30-minute ritual, you can create two wands from one original wand. The two new wands are identical to the original wand, but each contains half as many charges (round down for an odd number of charges). The original wand is destroyed during the ritual. Wand Division can only be used once per week.
